sourcePatch: content identity and durable deletion, schema6

checks.name: Imported native content identifier matches the managed original
v5-to-v6 migration preserves original, cover, pages and reading state
Renamed duplicate is rejected without another original or row; legacy hash is filled lazily
Same name with different contents remains a separate readable book
Forced hash-candidate collision does not discard byte-different content
An active reader protects the original and metadata from deletion
Deletion removes original, extracted cover/scroll cache and foreign-key reading/page/access rows
Deleting one book preserves other originals, ready pages and reading position
Partial deletion stays visible as retryable durable intent
Extraction cannot reset or resurrect a pending deletion
Retry completes partially deleted book without touching the other book
Startup resumes interrupted deletion intent
Missing originals are shown for explicit re-import
Explicit re-import rejects an identifier mismatch without replacing reading state
Explicit matching re-import restores the same book and preserves reading state
Deleting an already missing original still cleans the library
Native destination creation failure leaves no phantom book or picker copy
Import can retry after fixing native destination failure
v4-to-v6 migration preserves ready pages, geometry, cover and original with default reading settings
Page, source fraction, mode, direction and timestamp survive database reopen
Reading state is isolated per book and stores no sandbox file URI
Relative archive path survives stale URI and missing cache; reduced page count clamps the saved anchor
Actual SQLite failure rejects save, publishes a retryable warning and preserves persisted data
Retry commits the newest failed state and clears the shared warning
Serialized rapid saves restore the newest state rather than an older in-flight write
Cache eviction and regeneration preserve durable reading state
Pressure evicts old cache, protects active reader, preserves originals
Manual cleanup keeps active reader and removes other cache/page metadata
Evicted pages and cover regenerate from original on open
Uncommitted cache folders are removed before capacity accounting
v2-to-v3 migration preserves book/source metadata and requires new page cache
Mixed PNG/WebP/JPEG pages sorted naturally; hidden entries excluded
All three image formats decode from local files
First-page JPEG cover saved and decodable within size budget
Page order and sizes persist after reopening database
Decoder failure becomes a cover warning without crashing the library
v1 migration preserves metadata and restores relative source path
Validated CBZ commits ready state and three image files
Non-image entries are never extracted; original remains
Corrupt CBZ retains original and retryable error without cache output
Pre-cancel retains original source
Cancel during native extraction settles before cleanup and retains original
Retry after native cancellation completes
Reject traversal without extraction or loss of original
Reject symlink without extraction or loss of original
Reject imageless without extraction or loss of original
Reject bomb without extraction or loss of original
Reject empty without extraction or loss of original
Reject forged-size without extraction or loss of original
Restart removes staging/uncommitted final cache and restores retryable state
Retry after interruption completes
Purged extraction cache is recoverable after restart
Missing source resets ready state and removes stale extraction cache

scope: Android emulator API36. iOS, actual low-disk conditions, large-archive hash latency/memory and process-kill during deletion remain pending.
